id.description: Unique identifier for the blueprint recipe (e.g., blueprint_smelt_iron).

nameTerm.description: Localization token for the recipe name.

group.description: Conceptual category for filtering in Cardopedia (e.g. Industry, Nature, Cooking).

requiredCards.description: Multiset of Card IDs or abstract tags (e.g., ['iron_ore', 'wood', 'tag:worker']).

consumedInputs.description: Per-ingredient boolean flags dictating whether the item is destroyed upon completion.

time.description: Duration in seconds required to complete the crafting operation.

statusTerm.description: Localization token displayed above crafting progress bar.

priority.description: Explicit integer weighting used to break recipe match ambiguities.
